as_told.title: Site visit finding extra shafts near the Osiris shaft
as_told.place_text: Causeway near the Osiris shaft, Giza Plateau, Egypt

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum says he went out to the Giza Plateau in Egypt to look at the area around the Osiris Shaft, a deep shaft cut into the rock near the pyramids. He tells it as his own trip, and in one version says he went right after a conference in Malta and that extra shafts were found near the causeway, the old raised road leading to the pyramids. He ties the visit to water samples taken from the shaft and to his idea that the Great Pyramid made sulfuric acid, which, if true, would make it part of a large ancient energy system.
